stanzaProse: My soul in silence waits for God, My Saviour He has proved; He only is my rock and tow’r: I never shall be moved. My honor is secure with God, My Saviour He is known; My refuge and my rock of strength Are found in God alone.

For God has spoken o’er and o’er, And unto me has shown, That saving pow’r and lasting strength Belong to Him alone. Yea, loving-kindness evermore Belongs to Thee, O Lord; And Thou according to his work Dost ev’ry man reward.
qualification: Six alto quarters only. Retain source-system separator typography, straight/curly apostrophes, stanza 1 q23 tow’r: versus canonical tow'r;, and reconstructed lovingkindness versus printed loving-kindness. Initial shared tenor/bass quarter misreading and all baseline failures remain in the evidence directory.
